Pose - Looking Over Shoulder.description:
🕴️ Pose: Looking Over Shoulder
Turned partially away but looking back over one shoulder — a glance-back moment, inviting or cautious.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Looking Over Shoulder.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, turn the torso partly away and rotate the head back over one shoulder while keeping selected facial features, eyes, and expression readable when the frame includes them. Do not change camera angle, distance, or crop. Female: the turn carries through a long neck, the shoulder rolling forward. Male: the turn carries through a set neck, the shoulder holding square. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own turn.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
